'''Nels Olson Vaderless Probe Droid Deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Nels Olson]]
* '''Published:''' June 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm|Premiere-D-tatooinelarsmoisturefarm.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Vaderless Probe Droid Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDag Vaderless Probe Droid Deck Olson DS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I came in second in a recent sanctioned tournament using this as my dark deck. It does not feature Vader or Tarkin. Most of the other rares can be substituted for uncommons, making this potentially an inexpensive deck to put together. The most important cards for this deck are the 2 Captain Pietts. Other than that any pilot can substitute for other characters and uncommon star destroyers can substitute for the named ships. Alternatively, Vader and Tarkin would make this deck even stronger.

== Strategy ==

Using Probe Droids : The key to winning with this deck is in using Probe Droids to full advantage.

01. Use Captain Piett's game text to get them into your hand when you need them.

02. Deploy for free if Stalker is at the related system.

03. Get as many sites out as you can and deploy lots of probe droids to force drain at multiple sites. Use Ghkkk if opponent deploys in force at a site and initiates battle.

04. Use with undercover to block force drains when opponent starts deploying in force.

05. Put probe droids on starships for forfeit if you are in danger in space. Probe droids have forfeit value of 5 and you can get one out of your reserve deck when you need it if you have Piett on the table.

06.Use with Probe Droid Laser + Sniper + Undercover, and get rid of some of those ability 2 pilots.

When your opponent has deployed to counter probe droids, deploy your Blizzard Walkers. Hopefully your opponent will have spread out his forces to block force drains at all the different sites. Your Blizzard Walkers should be able to inflict heavy battle loses on the light side.

Weaknesses : You will probably need to have a lot of cards in play so you probably won't be able to win big with this deck. R3-PO can hurt you, fortunately you have at least 2 different ways to deal with him.
